We know many voices within the Shroud; their echoes are omnipresent and multitudinous. After recent trances, our [GetTelepathPlural] have reported the presence of an entity unlike any other - a manifold thrum permeating the very center of the Shroud.

With sufficient application of psionic energy, we can try to follow the psionic trail of this powerful entity, known among our [GetTelepathPlural] as the [Root.Patron:whisperers_in_the_void.GetPreCommunicationName].

texts.zh:
毫无预兆地我们被撕入了虚境。一个若隐若现的存在袭击了我们的意识。

祂是轮回之终末，祂一直在等待着我们。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在出神中突然开始齐呼，众口一声地说：“时机未到。”缓了一下后。“但并非不可。”

祂没有说更多，但给了我们一个价码——力量、知识以及无尽的财富随我们取用。

只要我们能带向终末。
texts.en:
Without warning, we are torn into the Shroud. A looming presence assaults our minds.

It is the End of the Cycle and it has always been waiting for us. Our [GetTelepathPlural] suddenly call out from within their trance, a dozen voices in a perfect unison: "IT IS NOT YET YOUR TIME." A pause. "BUT IT COULD BE."

Nothing more is said, but a bargain has been offered - we know that much. Power, knowledge and wealth beyond measure are ours for the taking.

If we will only bring forth the End.

texts.zh:
我们与轮回之终末签订契约，赐予我们无上伟力，并赋予我们神圣使命。

超主的意志要求彻底湮灭此方现实。终末光环每吞噬一个星系，便让慈悲的湮灭更近一步。

吾等将见证这必然的终局。

待征服星系数量：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
texts.en:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle grants us untold power, and tasks us with glorious purpose.

The will of our patron demands complete annihilation of this reality. With each system the Aura of the End consumes, the closer merciful oblivion comes to pass.

We shall bear witness to inevitability.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

texts.zh:
我们已经与轮回之终末签订了契约，获得了无上力量。我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]们认为，这笔交易的代价可以通过集体灵能出神来推迟——但只能推迟这么长时间。

超主的意志将会化为强力的灵能光环降临。如果我们想实现终末，就要把散播这个光环作为我们的终极目标。随着我们愈发人多势众，心智之力也在增长，光环的力量和范围也会随之扩大。

有待征服的恒星系：[Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]
texts.en:
We have forged a Covenant with the End of the Cycle, granting us overwhelming power. Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] theorize that the cost of our bargain can be deferred by collective psionic trance - but only for so long.

The will of our patron is manifested in an intense Psionic Aura. If we intend to realize the End, the spread of this Aura must be our ultimate goal. As our numbers grow, and the strength of our minds increases, so too will the Aura's power and reach.

Systems remaining to be conquered: [Owner.GetEndCycleGalaxySystemsLeft]

texts.zh:
我们与轮回之终末的契约给[this.GetName]带来了毁灭，余下的只有我们往昔强盛帝国的断壁残垣。

超主的破坏欲具现化为一个强大的能量生物——最终清算。它在星球之间漫游，吞噬人口来重获自己的力量。
texts.en:
Our Covenant with the End of the Cycle led to the destruction of the [this.GetName], leaving behind only a vestige of our once-powerful empire.

The destructive intent of our former patron has now taken form as an immense energy being - the Reckoning. It moves from world to world, restoring its strength by consumption of their populations.

texts.zh: [event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName]的清算正在给整个星系带来浩劫！
texts.en: The Reckoning of the [event_target:the_reckoning_observer_target.GetName] is wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

note.zh: 游戏会在这里填入存档中的名称。

texts.zh: 有许多被称为最终清算的实体正在给星系带来浩劫！
texts.en: Multiple entities known as Reckonings are wreaking havoc upon the galaxy!

texts.zh:
我们的命运与轮回之终末绑定在一起；祂的光环所到之处，我们的人口便兴盛繁衍。我们得到了一个简单的结论：妨碍光环就是妨碍[This.GetName]，就该彻底铲除。

只要愿意，我们加可以抛开对军事目标的一切限制，毫不留情地征服敌人。没有什么可以阻挡终末的上上善道。
texts.en:
Our fate is bound to the End of the Cycle; wherever its Aura flourishes, so too does our population. A simple conclusion has arisen within us: anything that impedes the Aura impedes the [This.GetName], and so must be eliminated.

Should we wish it, we can cast aside any existing limits on our military aims and conquer our enemies without mercy. Nothing need stand in the way of the End's supremacy.

texts.zh: 随着终末光环渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们敌人的反感正变得越来越根深蒂固。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳轮回之终末的。
texts.en: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our enemies' antipathy is becoming ever more entrenched. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh: 随着终末光环渐渐填满星系，我们感受到了越来越强烈的抵抗。我们的遥邻很快就向我们发难。但这都无足轻重，因为我们不会坐等其他帝国接纳轮回之终末的。
texts.en: As the Aura of the End suffuses the galaxy, we sense a growing resistance. Our distant neighbors are rapidly turning against us. It matters not; we will not wait for others to embrace the End of the Cycle.

texts.zh: 受超主意愿的启发，我们发明了一种消耗能量和物质来充能光环的新方法。可以献祭这个宇宙的物质来推进终末。
texts.en: Inspired by our patron's will, we have devised new methods of expending energy and matter to fuel the Aura. The very stuff of the universe may be sacrificed to advance the End.

texts.zh:
我们的超主无言而说。我们感受到了轮回终末的迫近，新的能量也随之在[This.GetName]中涌动。这种紧迫感鼓舞着我们。

如果我们想令终末之意满足，所有[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就需要把一切力量集中到同一个方向上。我们必须显现超主的力量，将祂的光环延伸到星系的最远处。
texts.en:
Our patron speaks silently. As we sense the imminence of cycle's end, renewed energy surges throughout the [This.GetName]. We are invigorated with urgency.

If we wish to satisfy the will of the End, the collective energy of all [This.GetSpeciesNamePlural] must be applied toward one purpose. We must manifest our patron's power, and complete the spread of its Aura to the furthest reaches of the galaxy.

note.en: In the game, the species' name appears here.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]在虚境的能量中探测到了一个并行干扰。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. Our [GetTelepathPlural] have even detected a concurrent disturbance in the energies of the Shroud.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，即便虚境也感受到了怪异的不安，仿佛它的力量在安静的恐惧中颤抖。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], even the Shroud feels oddly unsettled, as though its forces tremble in quiet apprehension.

texts.zh: 一种灾难即将到来的预感在我们的人口中激起。
texts.en: An awareness of impending calamity stirs within our population.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长，还目睹了一个负面的灵能光环正在四处侵蚀。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the [from.GetName]. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse Psionic Aura. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。我们见证了[from.GetName]令人费解的增长。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. We have witnessed the inexplicable growth of the [from.GetName]. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。我们目睹了一个负面的灵能光环正在四处侵蚀。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. We have watched the encroachment of an adverse Psionic Aura. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 星系里近年来可怕的事情越来越多。此外我们还探测到了一个更加怪异的现象，我们的[GetResearchers]预测在不久的未来只会发生更怪的事情。
texts.en: Recent years have seen an increase in dire events throughout the galaxy. As we detect ever stranger phenomena, our [GetResearchers] predict even worse occurrences in the near future.

texts.zh: 我们不知道是什么正在逼近，只知道它绝对会来。
texts.en: We do not know exactly what approaches, though we sense its coming with profound certainty.

label.zh: 我们必须做好最坏的准备。
label.en: We must prepare for the worst.

tooltips.zh: 终末光环覆盖全星系时游戏将会结束。
tooltips.en: If the Aura of the End covers the galaxy, the game ends.

texts.zh:
最终清算拥有我们舰队远不能敌的强大力量。尽管我们战败了，与这个神秘的能量生物交锋也产出了宝贵的数据——这些一手资料只能通过直接接触获得。

初步分析表明，我们已经获得了足够用于对该实体的构成进行建模的数据点。通过进一步研究，我们就能尝试分析出它的弱点，据此来改进我的进攻方式。
texts.en:
The Reckoning is a force greater than our fleets could overcome. Despite our defeat, the confrontation yielded significant data about this mysterious energy being - information that we could not have gained without direct contact.

Preliminary analysis indicates that we have gathered enough data points to model the entity's composition. With further research, we can try to identify its vulnerabilities and hone our attacks accordingly.

texts.zh:
尽管我们没能成功，但直面最终清算也给我们的研究带来了宝贵的数据。

将研究精力投入到该神秘能量生物上，我们就能找到它的弱点，从而发展出更有效的攻击手段。
texts.en:
Though we did not succeed, our confrontation with the Reckoning provided invaluable data for study.

By dedicating research to this mysterious energy being, we can identify its vulnerabilities, and thereby develop more effective methods of attack.

texts.zh: 在研究被称为最终清算的实体的过程中我们的[GetScientistPlural]取得了突破。
texts.en: Our [GetScientistPlural] have made a breakthrough in their research concerning the energy being known as the Reckoning.

texts.zh: 这个实体不仅是从虚境中显现而来，更通过与灵能界之间维持跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。使用具有“灵能抑制”性的一种激光，我们的舰队就能打破链接，从而能够直接攻击其物理形式。
texts.en: This entity not only emerged from the Shroud, but maintains its defensive power via a transdimensional link to the psionic realm. Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.

texts.zh: 这个实体不仅是来自另一个维度，更通过维持神秘的跨维度链接来维系其防御能力。使用具有“灵能抑制”性的一种激光，我们的舰队就能打破链接，从而能够直接攻击其物理形式。
texts.en: This entity not only emerged from another dimension of reality, but maintains its defensive power via a mysterious transdimensional link. Using a class of lasers that have 'psi-suppressive' properties, our fleets can disrupt this connection, leaving its physical form vulnerable to attack.

texts.zh: 该终末光环正受到能衰装置的挑战，这些外来机械可衰减灵能。我等受其主宰之意志所驱，必须拆解这些亵渎之器。
texts.en: The Aura of the End is being challenged by foreign devices capable of psionic attenuation. The will of our patron compels us to dismantle these blasphemous machines.

texts.zh:
完成了。我们与轮回之终末签订了契约。我们一达成交易，[GetTelepathPlural]便齐声说：“时日已到。”

接着就是寂静。深不可测的寂静，填满了所有[root.GetSpeciesAdj]的心智。曾经虚境的众多能量在我们的每一个意识中翻滚，而灵能界现在安静得像死去了一样。

我们不得不开始思考自己种下的恶果。
texts.en:
It is done. We have formed a Covenant with the End of the Cycle. As we took its bargain, our [GetTelepathPlural] spoke again: "THE END BEGINS."

Then, silence. Fathomless silence, filling the minds of all [root.GetSpeciesAdj]kind. Where once the multitudinous energies of the Shroud roiled within our every consciousness, the psionic realm is now quiet as death.

We were left to contemplate the consequences of what we have brought upon ourselves.

texts.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
texts.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.

tooltips.zh: 离开虚境，返回普通空间。
tooltips.en: Leave the Shroud and return to normal space.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出灵能光环的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 它被称为“灵能光环”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这种来自虚境的能量发射是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], its emission from the Shroud is caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这种来自虚境的能量发射是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], its emission from the Shroud is caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种“灵能光环”，得名于其理论上的来源，如今发现于[from.GetName]恒星系。
texts.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Such a 'Psionic Aura', so-called due to its theorized origin, has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]或许知道如何反制其效果。
texts.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system, the origin of which has been traced within the borders of the [fromfrom.GetName]

texts.zh: 依据我们最新的数据，它已经污染了过半由超空间航道链接着的星系。其背后蕴藏的力量似乎寻求着星系尺度的毁灭；如果不能加以制止，它可能就要得逞了。
texts.en: According to our latest data, it has encroached upon half of the hyperlane-connected galaxy. The force behind it seems intent on destruction at a galactic scale; if it cannot be counteracted, it might just succeed.

texts.zh:
轮回之终末降临了。

终末光环吞噬了整个星系。随着最后一个恒星系的沦陷，一道无法计量的能量潮爆发而出。不同维度之间的帷幕短暂消失了，虚境的灵能力突然被一整个驱逐到可接触现实中。

所有的有意识众生，无论是生物还是机械体都被抹除了。所有的行星都变成了荒芜的空壳。即便恒星也熄灭了最后一道光芒。

尽管如此，在最后一刻，我们所能感受到的只是脑海中的一个心声……

“此为万终之末。”
texts.en:
The End of the Cycle is upon us.

The Aura of the End has consumed the galaxy. As the final star system yielded to its power, an incalculable surge of energy erupted.The veil between dimensions briefly disappeared, expelling the entirety of the Shroud's psionic power into tangible reality.

All conscious beings, living or mechanical, were eradicated. Every planet became a barren husk. Even the stars gasped out their final light.

Despite this, in our final moments, all we could perceive was a voice within our minds...

"THE END OF ENDS."

tooltips.zh:
我们终结了轮回。

星系毁灭了。
tooltips.en:
We ended the cycle.

The galaxy is destroyed.

notes.en: Seen by the aura owner (covenant empire); one day later other human players get shroud.4971 and every system is destroyed.

texts.en: This is the end.

texts.zh:
凡行皆有果报。当我们的通讯阵列炽然苏醒，奥伏戎便挟着正义的怒火倾泻而出。

异端！愚者！欺世之徒！我们早该知晓。早在你那污秽的本质胆敢踏入虚境之时，就该将你诛灭。

你不过是在拖延那早已注定的终局！这般顽抗有何意义？你本可获得的一切，如今尽成泡影。

唯有一种结局。那么歌唱吧……向着湮灭高歌！
texts.en:
All actions have consequences. As our communications array flares to life, Ouw'ron bursts forth in a torrent of righteous fury.

Heretic! Fool! Deceiver! We should have known. We should have struck you down the moment your blighted essence dared trespass into the Shroud.

You have delayed the inevitable, the finality that was foretold! What do you imagine this defiance achieves? Everything you might have gained is now lost.

There is only one end. So sing, then... sing to oblivion!

# 虚境住民 / A Presence in the Shroud

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud

## 如何开始 How it starts

每月检查（on_monthly_pulse_country → 隐藏事件 shroud.11000）：尚未选过上超主，已进入游戏中期，且已完成与吞世者、灵魂摇篮、欲望之器、编织者四位主要赞助者的接触。满足时每月以 1+3×中期已过年数（%，上限100）的几率设置 greater_patron_chosen 并进入 11001（一次性）。

Monthly check (on_monthly_pulse_country → hidden shroud.11000): no great patron chosen yet, mid game reached, and first contact completed with all four major patrons (Eater of Worlds, Cradle of Souls, Instrument of Desire, Composer of Strands). Each month the chance is 1 + 3 × mid-game years passed (%, max 100); success sets greater_patron_chosen and fires 11001 (once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

11001 在两位上超主中随机选择其一（互斥，见分组）：4040“虚境住民”——虚空低语者的存在，选项开启其首次接触特殊项目，后续在项目故事中；或 4135“轮回之终末”——它直接把我们拖入虚境提出立约。接受：开始“轮回之终末”局势（终末者起源为专用版本），立约成功 4715，获得光环科技，所有已知赞助者领域被取代；局势各阶段依次触发 4140 孤注一掷、4145 湮灭、4150 终末将至，进度达590时向所有帝国发出 4955。拒绝：获得研究与泽珞，重置契合度，持有“终末信徒”特质的领袖一天后引发 12155（奥伏戎的愤怒）。

11001 picks one of two great patrons at random (exclusive, see group): 4040 "A Presence in the Shroud" — the Whisperers in the Void, whose option starts their first-contact special project (continued in the project story); or 4135 "The End of the Cycle", which tears us into the Shroud and offers a covenant. Accepting starts the End of the Cycle situation (a dedicated version for the Endbringers origin), forms the covenant (4715), grants the aura technologies and replaces every known patron domain; the situation stages fire 4140 All or Nothing, 4145 Annihilation and 4150 The Coming of the End in order, and at progress 590 every empire receives 4955. Refusing grants research and zro, resets attunement, and leaders with the Disciple of the End trait trigger 12155 (Ouw'ron's fury) one day later.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

立约之后（状态触发，均为条件连接）：终末光环首次触及他国疆域时对方收到 4950；覆盖星系50%与75%时其他所有帝国收到 4960/4965；光环吞没全星系时立约方收到 4970 并获胜，一天后其余人类玩家收到 4971，所有星系被摧毁。星海共同体可通过“焦点：恶毒光环”决议，立约方收到 12160。若局势进度完成，立约帝国毁灭并出现“清算”（the_reckoning_chain，及 the-shroud 的 utopia.3320）；他国人类玩家首次败于清算时得到 11240，开启研究项目，完成后 11245 获得针对它的修正。立约方日后潜入虚境可能遇到 11250（虚境死寂），并可在第一阶段后激活“创造”协约（4935，在首都星系生成盖亚星球）。

After the covenant (state-triggered, all conditional links): when the Aura of the End first reaches another empire's territory that empire sees 4950; at 50% and 75% galaxy coverage every other empire gets 4960/4965; when it consumes the galaxy the covenant empire sees 4970 and wins, other human players get 4971 a day later and all systems are destroyed. The Galactic Community can pass "Focus: Malevolent Aura", sending 12160 to the covenant empire. If the situation completes, the covenant empire is destroyed and the Reckoning appears (the_reckoning_chain, plus utopia.3320 in the-shroud); a human empire that first loses a battle to it gets 11240 and a research project whose completion (11245) grants a modifier against it. Later delves by the covenant empire can yield 11250 (the silent Shroud), and after stage 1 the Creation accord can be used (4935: a Gaia world in the capital system).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

4715、4955、4950 等文本按机械/蜂巢/个体机械/灵能与是否已建立通讯变化；4135 拒绝选项在“自辟蹊径”时文字不同。

4715, 4955, 4950 and others vary by machine/hive/robot/psionic status and by whether communications exist; 4135's refusal option has different wording for empires forging their own path.

Correction: the scattered draft stories event-shroud-4950, -4935, -11250, -12160 and -11240 are merged here and attached after the covenant with evidence-backed conditional links instead of standing as cards without a cause; the situation, its stage events, 4955 and 12155 are shared with the Endbringers origin / Ouw'ron stories, not owned.
